rec.name: PDP Multiple Product Videos (Metafield-driven, Popup)
rec.status: Built — delivered by Rana, documentation reviewed (Slite)

what.text: A PDP block that shows a headline (e.g. "Die Verwendung" / how to use) with a row of round video thumbnail buttons, each with a label underneath (e.g. "STYLE", "TEST"). Clicking a button opens a modal popup with the video (default 340px wide) next to a details list. The details list uses an icon, a title, a thumbnail and a paragraph per item (read from the code's CSS classes, I). The original ticket asked for a "Multiple Produktvideos" section with a headline, sub-headline, and one sub-section per video (thumbnail, video, title, popup description). The final build is a block with limit 1 inside main-product.liquid, named "PDP| MPV via Metafields". It stays hidden unless the product has metaobject values.

why.text: Short usage or style videos show the product in real use and answer "how does it look or work?" without a long text. This lowers uncertainty and the perceived risk of buying. Putting the videos in a popup keeps the PDP compact and the buyer in context, with no page navigation. Round, labeled thumbnails invite a tap and make the content easy to scan.

how.text: 1) Set up a metaobject definition with video, thumbnail, title and description (and the detail entries). 2) Create a product metafield (list of metaobjects) named cro_multiple_product_videos in the standard namespace. 3) Add the schema block "pdp_mvp_via_metafields" (limit 1) to the schema of main-product.liquid. 4) Create the snippet pdp-multiple-product-videos-via-metafields.liquid. It reads the metafield, renders the headline and the thumbnail button list, and outputs scoped <style> for the block settings. It also renders the modal with video and detail list, and the open/close JS. 5) In the theme editor, add the block to the product template and fill in the metafield on each product. The block only renders if the metafield has a value. The supplied code was truncated (mobile CSS, markup and JS are not fully visible).

items: Heading text (rich text), font size (desktop + mobile), color
Thumbnail button: size, space top, gap, style (circle/square), border on/off and color, circle color, show play icon + size + color, label font size (desktop + mobile)
Popup: gap (desktop + mobile), heading color / uppercase / font size, close button color + size
Popup video: width, corner radius, controls on/off, autoplay (default on), loop (default on)
Popup content list: gap, icon width/color/background/corner radius/gap, title color + size, thumbnail width + corner radius, paragraph color + size (desktop + mobile)

dependencies.text: Product metafield product.metafields.standard.cro_multiple_product_videos (list of metaobjects) plus a matching metaobject definition (video, thumbnail, title, description). Must be set up in Shopify admin under Custom Data. Edit access to main-product.liquid. The theme needs a modal close-button component (class modal__close-button, which looks like Dawn/Horizon-style markup, I). Ticket field: metafield required (MF/N), built by Rana, "Einbau durch Non Devs" still to be clarified. The ticket field says Section, but the delivered code is a block inside main-product.

items: Video play rate and completion rate
PDP add-to-cart rate for sessions with video interaction vs. without
Conversion rate and revenue per visitor (A/B test)
PDP bounce rate / time on page
Return rate for products with usage videos (secondary)

Settings panel of the block: Metaobject & Metafield notice, background, space top/bottom (desktop/mobile), alignment, heading settings.
